overview.executive_summary: The most consequential developments include active exploitation of enterprise vulnerabilities, hardware supply-chain compromise, attacks against telecom and cloud infrastructure, and major international disruption of malware operations.

sections.heading: CISA adds two vulnerabilities to its exploited catalog
sections.what_happened: CISA added CVE-2026-114713 affecting UnrealIRCd and CVE-2026-123039 affecting Check Point products to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing active exploitation.
sections.why_it_matters: The catalog identifies vulnerabilities that pose significant risks and require rapid remediation for affected federal systems.
sections.recommended_attention: Check exposed assets for both CVEs and prioritize remediation and compromise assessment.

sections.heading: Trezor wallets contained crypto-stealing implants
sections.what_happened: Trezor confirmed that three Safe 5 devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis contained hidden hardware implants that copied recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks.
sections.why_it_matters: The incident demonstrates a direct hardware supply-chain attack against cryptocurrency recovery credentials.
sections.recommended_attention: Verify reseller provenance and inspect affected devices before using them.

sections.heading: Cyberattack disrupted German military drone operations
sections.what_happened: Quantum Systems said it detected an incident in late October that was part of an active cyberattack by hostile actors and affected drone operations.
sections.why_it_matters: The incident shows how cyberattacks can disrupt defense technology and operational capabilities.
sections.recommended_attention: Review access controls, incident evidence, and resilience for systems supporting military drone operations.

sections.heading: Check Point gateways were used to deploy a wiper
sections.what_happened: Attackers targeted unpatched Check Point Security Gateways through PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, deployed the TSGA backdoor, and wiped files on VMware ESXi hosts.
sections.why_it_matters: The activity combined perimeter-device compromise, privilege escalation, persistence, and destructive impact against virtualization infrastructure.
sections.recommended_attention: Patch exposed gateways, investigate for TSGA, and protect ESXi systems from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: N-able N-central zero-day was exploited after public disclosure
sections.what_happened: Attackers exploited the newly disclosed 4EverAble2Shell flaws against N-central servers and deployed cryptocurrency miners; researchers reported at least 21 affected systems, including 19 running the latest security update.
sections.why_it_matters: The campaign shows rapid exploitation of a remote-management platform used in enterprise environments.
sections.recommended_attention: Apply vendor mitigations, restrict vulnerable N-central features, and examine systems for mining activity.

sections.heading: Thousands of GitHub accounts were used to steal cloud credentials
sections.what_happened: The wfx-loot campaign used 4,837 compromised GitHub accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware.
sections.why_it_matters: Compromised developer identities and repository activity can expose cloud credentials across many organizations.
sections.recommended_attention: Audit GitHub identities, repositories, pull requests, secrets, and unusual automation activity.

sections.heading: PostgreSQL fixed an authenticated remote-code-execution flaw
sections.what_happened: PostgreSQL updates fixed 52 flaws, including CVE-2026-6460, a type-confusion vulnerability that lets a database user who can create objects execute code on the server.
sections.why_it_matters: The flaw is long-standing, carries a CVSS score of 8.8, and full protection also requires rebuilding installed C-language extensions.
sections.recommended_attention: Update PostgreSQL, review object-creation privileges, and rebuild affected extensions.

sections.heading: Attacks exposed weaknesses in AMD confidential virtual machines
sections.what_happened: The Mior and Skyfall attacks allow a malicious host to read data inside AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines; Mior can also modify memory and fake a signed software report.
sections.why_it_matters: The findings challenge protections designed to keep cloud or server operators from accessing guest virtual-machine data.
sections.recommended_attention: Assess trust assumptions for hosted confidential-computing deployments and monitor hypervisor and firmware control.

sections.heading: FBI linked more than $400 million in crypto theft to deepfake video calls
sections.what_happened: The FBI said North Korean-linked actors stole more than $400 million in cryptocurrency over 18 months through the FaceStealer social-engineering scheme, including deepfake video calls.
sections.why_it_matters: The campaign combines identity deception and social engineering to target high-value cryptocurrency operations.
sections.recommended_attention: Strengthen hiring, transaction-approval, and video-verification procedures for crypto-related roles.

sections.heading: SilentAir intercepted SMS two-factor codes through telecom networks
sections.what_happened: The SilentAir group used hacked equipment inside Asian mobile operators to intercept calls and texts of selected people, mostly in Taiwan. Enea assessed with high confidence that it is a state-level actor.
sections.why_it_matters: Compromised telecom infrastructure can defeat SMS-based two-factor authentication and enable targeted surveillance.
sections.recommended_attention: Prefer phishing-resistant authentication and investigate telecom-provider trust and signaling risks.

sections.heading: Operation Endgame dismantled malware infrastructure
sections.what_happened: An international police operation seized servers and domains used by Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC, along with about 6.4 million stolen logins belonging to more than 40,000 victims.
sections.why_it_matters: The operation disrupted malware used to steal passwords, gain computer access, and launch ransomware attacks.
sections.recommended_attention: Rotate potentially exposed credentials and review endpoint and identity telemetry for related infections.

sections.heading: SCKit expanded ScreenConnect attacks through MSPs
sections.what_happened: The worm-like SCKit toolkit was deployed in ScreenConnect attacks targeting managed service providers and was designed to spread from customer devices to MSP technicians and additional managed networks.
sections.why_it_matters: Compromising an MSP can create a path into many downstream customer environments.
sections.recommended_attention: Patch ScreenConnect, isolate administrative systems, and review lateral movement between providers and customers.

tts.text: Here is your cybersecurity news briefing. CISA, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, added two actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, affecting UnrealIRCd and Check Point products. A separate campaign used flaws in Check Point gateways to deploy a backdoor and wipe VMware ESXi files. Trezor also confirmed hidden implants in three crypto wallets, stealing recovery phrases through cellular networks. Remote-management platforms remain under pressure: attackers exploited N-able N-central flaws against at least 21 servers, while SCKit malware used ScreenConnect attacks to spread through managed service providers, or MSPs. GitHub was hit by a campaign involving 4,837 compromised accounts and tens of thousands of repositories. Elsewhere, researchers disclosed attacks against AMD confidential virtual machines, and SilentAir reportedly intercepted calls and SMS two-factor codes through Asian telecom networks. The FBI attributed more than 400 million dollars in cryptocurrency theft to North Korean-linked actors using deepfake video calls. Finally, Operation Endgame seized malware infrastructure and about 6.4 million stolen logins.
